lp.metaTitle: Open an online rental store with your own link
lp.metaDescription: Sign up free, design your store page, take bookings by bank transfer with receipt verification. No commission.
lp.heroTitle: Your own rental page. Bookings come in, you stay in control.
lp.heroSub: Sign up free, design your store page, add items and bank accounts. Customers book from your link, transfer, and upload the receipt. You just confirm.
lp.heroNote: No commission. Payments go straight to your bank account.
lp.stepsTitle: From signup to your first booking.
lp.stepsSub: Four steps, all from the same dashboard.
lp.step1Title: Sign up and pick your store address
lp.step1Body: Your store name becomes a link: {host}/your-store. Share it on Instagram and WhatsApp.
lp.step2Title: Add items, prices, and bank accounts
lp.step2Body: Hourly or daily prices, stock, deposits, and the accounts customers transfer to.
lp.step3Body: Pick colours, a font, and the order of sections. Preview live before going public.
lp.step4Body: Customers book, transfer, and upload the receipt. You confirm from the dashboard, they get an email.
lp.builderBody: Nineteen components you can add, lay out in columns, reorder, and hide, on the home page and on extra pages. Colours, font, logo, and menu are yours to set.
lp.builderPoint1: Hero, item grid, item spotlight, columns, features, testimonials, gallery, FAQ, contact, map, video, and more.
lp.builderPoint2: Extra pages for terms & conditions or your story.
lp.builderPoint3: Save as a draft, preview, publish when ready.
lp.featuresTitle: What you get from day one.
lp.f1Body: A store address that is easy to remember and share, with no domain or hosting to buy.
lp.f2Body: Stock is counted automatically per date. No double bookings for the same unit.
lp.f3Body: Customers upload the transfer receipt. You accept or reject it in one click.
lp.f4Body: Unpaid bookings expire on their own and the stock becomes available again.
lp.f5Body: You and your customers get an email at every change of booking status.
lp.f6Body: Invite staff to help verify payments and hand items over.
lp.paySub: Bank transfer, receipt, confirmation. No payment gateway, no cut.
lp.pay1Body: The booking is created with a unique code and a payment deadline. Stock is held immediately.
lp.pay2Body: The customer transfers to your account and uploads the receipt from the booking page.
lp.pay3Body: You check the receipt in the dashboard and confirm. The customer gets an email right away.
lp.pay4Body: Mark handover and return. The history is kept.
lp.payNote: A rejected receipt can be re-uploaded within a new deadline. Bookings past their deadline expire automatically.
lp.faq1A: Nothing. No monthly fee and no commission per booking. Customer payments go straight to your bank account.
lp.faq2A: By bank transfer to the accounts you register. Customers upload the receipt; you verify it from the dashboard.
lp.faq3Q: Can I use my own domain?
lp.faq3A: Not yet. Each store has an address under the platform domain. Custom domains are planned.
lp.faq4A: Anything rented by the hour or day: vehicles, camping gear, cameras, costumes, party equipment, and more.
lp.faq5A: Per date and hour. Bookings awaiting payment hold stock until their deadline, then release it automatically if unpaid.
lp.ctaSub: Create an account, add one item, share your store link on {platform}. The rest can follow.
